an7.47:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena uggatasarīrassa brāhmaṇassa mahāyañño upakkhaṭo hoti
an7.47:1.2: pañca usabhasatāni thūṇupanītāni honti yaññatthāya pañca vacchatarasatāni thūṇupanītāni honti yaññatthāya pañca vacchatarisatāni thūṇupanītāni honti yaññatthāya pañca ajasatāni thūṇupanītāni honti yaññatthāya pañca urabbhasatāni thūṇupanītāni honti yaññatthāya
an7.47:1.3: athakho uggatasarīro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an7.47:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho uggatasarīro brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an7.47:2.1: sutaṃ metaṃ bho gotama aggissa ādhānaṃ yūpassa ussāpanaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsanti.
an7.47:2.2: mayāpi kho etaṃ brāhmaṇa sutaṃ aggissa ādhānaṃ yūpassa ussāpanaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsanti.
an7.47:2.4: tatiyampi kho uggatasarīro brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an7.47:2.5: sutaṃ metaṃ bho gotama aggissa ādhānaṃ yūpassa ussāpanaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsanti.
an7.47:2.6: mayāpi kho etaṃ brāhmaṇa sutaṃ aggissa ādhānaṃ yūpassa ussāpanaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsanti.
an7.47:2.7: tayidaṃ bho gotama sameti bhotoceva gotamassa amhākañca yadidaṃ sabbena sabbanti.
an7.47:3.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando uggatasarīraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca
an7.47:3.2: na kho brāhmaṇa tathāgatā evaṃ pucchitabbā
an7.47:3.3: sutaṃ metaṃ bho gotama aggissa ādhānaṃ yūpassa ussāpanaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsanti
an7.47:3.5: ahañhi bhante aggiṃ ādhātukāmo yūpaṃ ussāpetukāmo
an7.47:3.7: anusāsatu maṃ bhante bhagavā yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
an7.47:4.2: ahañhi bho gotama aggiṃ ādhātukāmo yūpaṃ ussāpetukāmo
an7.47:4.4: anusāsatu maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
an7.47:5.1: aggiṃ brāhmaṇa ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubbeva yaññe tīṇi satthāni ussāpeti akusalāni dukkhudrayāni dukkhavipākāni.
an7.47:5.4: aggiṃ brāhmaṇa ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubbeva yaññe evaṃ cittaṃ uppādeti
an7.47:5.5: ettakā usabhā haññantu yaññatthāya ettakā vacchatarā haññantu yaññatthāya ettakā vacchatariyo haññantu yaññatthāya ettakā ajā haññantu yaññatthāya ettakā urabbhā haññantu yaññatthāyāti
an7.47:5.6: so puññaṃ karomīti apuññaṃ karoti kusalaṃ karomīti akusalaṃ karoti sugatiyā maggaṃ pariyesāmīti duggatiyā maggaṃ pariyesati
an7.47:5.7: aggiṃ brāhmaṇa ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubbeva yaññe idaṃ paṭhamaṃ manosatthaṃ ussāpeti akusalaṃ dukkhudrayaṃ dukkhavipākaṃ.
an7.47:6.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇa aggiṃ ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubbeva yaññe evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati
an7.47:6.2: ettakā usabhā haññantu yaññatthāya ettakā vacchatarā haññantu yaññatthāya ettakā vacchatariyo haññantu yaññatthāya ettakā ajā haññantu yaññatthāya ettakā urabbhā haññantu yaññatthāyāti
an7.47:6.3: so puññaṃ karomīti apuññaṃ karoti kusalaṃ karomīti akusalaṃ karoti sugatiyā maggaṃ pariyesāmīti duggatiyā maggaṃ pariyesati
an7.47:6.4: aggiṃ brāhmaṇa ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubbeva yaññe idaṃ dutiyaṃ vacīsatthaṃ ussāpeti akusalaṃ dukkhudrayaṃ dukkhavipākaṃ.
an7.47:7.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇa aggiṃ ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubbeva yaññe sayaṃ paṭhamaṃ samārabhati usabhā haññantu yaññatthāya sayaṃ paṭhamaṃ samārabhati vacchatarā haññantu yaññatthāya sayaṃ paṭhamaṃ samārabhati vacchatariyo haññantu yaññatthāya sayaṃ paṭhamaṃ samārabhati ajā haññantu haññatthāya sayaṃ paṭhamaṃ samārabhati urabbhā haññantu yaññatthāyāti
an7.47:7.2: so puññaṃ karomīti apuññaṃ karoti kusalaṃ karomīti akusalaṃ karoti sugatiyā maggaṃ pariyesāmīti duggatiyā maggaṃ pariyesati
an7.47:7.3: aggiṃ brāhmaṇa ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubbeva yaññe idaṃ tatiyaṃ kāyasatthaṃ ussāpeti akusalaṃ dukkhudrayaṃ dukkhavipākaṃ
an7.47:7.4: aggiṃ brāhmaṇa ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubbeva yaññe imāni tīṇi satthāni ussāpeti akusalāni dukkhudrayāni dukkhavipākāni.
an7.47:8.1: tayome brāhmaṇa aggī pahātabbā parivajjetabbā na sevitabbā.
an7.47:9.1: kasmā cāyaṃ brāhmaṇa rāgaggi pahātabbo parivajjetabbo na sevitabbo
an7.47:9.2: ratto kho brāhmaṇa rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati
an7.47:9.3: so kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati
an7.47:9.4: tasmā cāyaṃ rāgaggi pahātabbo parivajjetabbo na sevitabbo.
an7.47:10.1: kasmā cāyaṃ brāhmaṇa dosaggi pahātabbo parivajjetabbo na sevitabbo
an7.47:10.2: duṭṭho kho brāhmaṇa dosena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati
an7.47:10.3: so kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati
an7.47:10.4: tasmā cāyaṃ dosaggi pahātabbo parivajjetabbo na sevitabbo.
an7.47:11.1: kasmā cāyaṃ brāhmaṇa mohaggi pahātabbo parivajjetabbo na sevitabbo
an7.47:11.2: mūḷho kho brāhmaṇa mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati
an7.47:11.3: so kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati
an7.47:11.4: tasmā cāyaṃ mohaggi pahātabbo parivajjetabbo na sevitabbo.
an7.47:11.5: ime kho brāhmaṇa tayo aggī pahātabbā parijjetabbā na sevitabbā.
an7.47:12.1: tayome brāhmaṇa aggī sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā sammā sukhaṃ parihātabbā.
an7.47:13.2: idha brāhmaṇa yassa te honti mātāti vā pitāti vā ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa āhuneyyaggi
an7.47:13.4: atohāyaṃ brāhmaṇa āhuto sambhūto tasmā cāyaṃ āhuneyyaggi sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā sammā sukhaṃ parihātabbo.
an7.47:14.2: idha brāhmaṇa yassa te honti puttāti vā dārāti vā dāsāti vā pessāti vā ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa gahapataggi
an7.47:14.3: tasmā cāyaṃ gahapataggi sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā sammā sukhaṃ parihātabbo.
an7.47:15.2: idha brāhmaṇa ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā madappamādā paṭiviratā khantisoracce niviṭṭhā ekamattānaṃ damenti ekamattānaṃ samenti ekamattānaṃ parinibbāpenti ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa dakkhiṇeyyaggi
an7.47:15.3: tasmā cāyaṃ dakkhiṇeyyaggi sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā sammā sukhaṃ parihātabbo.
an7.47:15.4: ime kho brāhmaṇa tayo aggī sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā sammā sukhaṃ parihātabbā.
an7.47:16.1: ayaṃ kho pana brāhmaṇa kaṭṭhaggi kālena kālaṃ ujjaletabbo kālena kālaṃ ajjhupekkhitabbo kālena kālaṃ nibbāpetabbo kālena kālaṃ nikkhipitabboti.
an7.47:17.1: evaṃ vutte uggatasarīro brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an7.47:17.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ
an7.47:17.4: esāhaṃ bho gotama pañca usabhasatāni muñcāmi jīvitaṃ demi pañca vacchatarasatāni muñcāmi jīvitaṃ demi pañca vacchatarisatāni muñcāmi jīvitaṃ demi pañca ajasatāni muñcāmi jīvitaṃ demi pañca urabbhasatāni muñcāmi jīvitaṃ demi
an7.47:17.5: haritāni ceva tiṇāni khādantu sītāni ca pāniyāni pivantu sīto ca nesaṃ vāto upavāyatūti.
